title: Open Carrier Data device records (generated/devices/carrier-variants.json)
description: What one device's own carrier file configures for VoLTE, Wi-Fi calling, video calling and VoNR on one carrier profile. Configuration, not a test result. tools/validate_carrier_variants.py checks what a schema cannot: published profiles, catalog devices, capability_sources, the data digest, rule 7 and canonical order.

state.description: on or off as the device's own file writes it; conditional when two files of the same device (overlay layers) disagree. A missing key is never a record.

stack.description: The software the value holds for: stock firmware (Samsung, Google, Fairphone), a LineageOS device tree, or Sony's AOSP tree.

newest_entry.description: Month of the newest upstream entry behind the value; absent when an entry is undated. Rule 7 withholds a value older than five years, so no record is older.

devices.description: Sorted. android:<device_id> from generated/devices/android.json, or samsung:<Build.MODEL> for a Samsung model the catalog lists.

basis.description: Only on vonr from samsung_omc, where the evidence index's capability_basis names it.
